primary_question: Whether domain-task-specific prediction paths can adapt after a shared representation update and whether a fixed shared-to-private update order yields an independent ranking gain.
candidate_algorithm: U_to_P shared-to-private sequential coordination with one pre-registered scope selected by Stage 1 response diagnostics; no online controller.
test_policy: No Test access before S3 freeze; one-shot scoring only for frozen arms.
prohibited: No modification of historical experiment code or artifacts
No Gaussian/PAIR/ECCM/NQR combination in the primary method
No adaptive EMA or new gradient-conflict controller
